title: Battle of Ukino
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Ukino", at revision 1370276009, opens: "Battle of Ukino was the final victory of Oda Nobunaga in his struggle to unite the province of Owari against his cousin, Oda Nobukata, deputy governor of northern Owari." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q11149463, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1558 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
